RESOLVED: Dear Dana, 

I am writing to follow up on your denied claim for the brain MRI on August 27. The denial reason was "prior authorization not on file". You have the right to appeal this decision within 180 days of the denial notice date. 

To appeal, your ordering provider, Dr. L. Okonjo, can submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting the medical necessity of the MRI for your migraines. We will review this request and make a decision within 30 calendar days. 

The exact deadline for your appeal is 180 days from the denial notice date. I have attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) to this message for your convenience. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. 

Please note that we have mirrored your file to our sync service as per our standard procedure. 

Sincerely,
ARIA, Meridian Health Plan Member Services Agent
